notes: site.baseUrl is the one place the published address of this site is written.
It is used for the canonical URL on every page, for sitemap.xml, for the links on the 404 page, and for the CNAME file.
Leave it empty and the build uses PTD_BASE_URL instead, which the deploy workflow sets to the GitHub Pages address. That is how the site publishes before a domain is registered.
When a domain is registered, put it here. One line. Include the scheme, no trailing slash, for example https://plaintradedesk.org
A host that is not a github.io subdomain also causes the build to write dist/CNAME, which is what tells GitHub Pages to answer on that name.
